title: Output of the streaming emitter
statement: For every bit string $x$, concatenate the emitted chunks from rounds $i=0$ through $|x|$, where each round uses the encoded next-state iterate after $i$ steps starting from the encoded startup state for $x$. This concatenation equals the serialization of the clause-splitting transform of the decoded CNF formula for $x$.
replaced:
For every binary string $x$, concatenating over $i < |x| + 1$ the chunks produced
by the encoded chunk function at the $i$-fold iterate of the encoded next-state
function on the encoded startup word equals the image of $x$ under the
string-level SAT-to-3SAT reduction — exactly the expression returned by the
emitting-loop constructor with round budget $R(n) = n$.
